submitted_prompt:
Using Image 1 as the sole character, equipment and pixel-style reference, create a four-frame pixel-art collapse animation in a 2-column by 2-row sheet, chronological reading order. Preserve this grounded adult raider: bone mask, tied dark hair, charcoal wraps and full torn trousers, ochre sash, leather bracers, brown boots, and the broad curved bronze axe held by the anatomical RIGHT hand, visible on screen-left in this lower-left-facing view.

Animate one continuous fall toward lower-left:
1. Recoil and lose balance: chest rocks back, knees soften, the right hand still holds the axe low.
2. Knees buckle: pelvis drops, both knees bend deeply and the torso pitches forward; the same axe arm lowers toward the ground.
3. Fall: knees touch down as the torso tips close to horizontal toward lower-left, the free left forearm reaches to break the fall, and the right-hand axe follows beside that right arm.
4. Settle: the whole body lies motionless on its front/side on the ground, head toward lower-left and legs trailing upper-right. The same axe rests on the ground beside the right hand, with its handle still meeting the loosened fingers. Make this clearly a fallen body, not a kneeling or sleeping upright pose.

Keep the camera, lighting, adult anatomy, apparent body size, palette and pixel pitch unchanged across all four frames. Use about64 logical pixels for the standing body, deliberate square pixel clusters and at most32 purposeful colors. Preserve one shared world ground origin through the fall; do not recenter or enlarge the low poses to fill their cells. Give every cell enough room for the complete fallen body and axe. All four face the same lower-left world direction, with natural rotation only from collapsing. No gore, green clothing, effects, floor shadows, labels, frame borders or other characters. Return actual transparent RGBA, with no painted transparency pattern. Slicing, exact canvas placement and animation timing will be handled separately.
